records.title: Agent-Centric Observation Adaptation for Robust Visual Control under Dynamic Perturbations
records.reason: Robust visual-control observation adaptation, not LLM serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Automated End-to-End Model Serving with Cooperative Compilation and Scheduling
records.reason: The abstract describes Infera cooperative compilation and runtime scheduling for model serving and claims at least 1.6x throughput over baselines, but the ACM DOI primary text was inaccessible; the claim cannot be verified from full text.

records.title: Back to BERT in 2026: ModernGENA as a Strong, Efficient Baseline for DNA Foundation Models
records.reason: Efficient DNA foundation-model baseline, a domain-specific biological model rather than a plausible LLM inference/serving contribution.

records.title: DynamicRad: Content-Adaptive Sparse Attention for Long Video Diffusion
records.reason: DynamicRad uses static-ratio/dynamic-threshold sparse attention and an offline semantic-motion router for video diffusion; HunyuanVideo/Wan2.1 results claim 1.7–2.5x inference speedup and >80% sparsity. This is adjacent long-context/sparse-attention evidence but limited to video diffusion and specific block sizes/hardware.

records.title: Scalable Memristive-Friendly Reservoir Computing for Time Series Classification
records.reason: Memristive reservoir computing for time-series classification, outside language-model inference.
